description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans silo membership liveness functionality using different relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) as the membership provider. It defines test classes for each database type, configuring the Orleans cluster to use ADO.NET clustering with the specified database, and includes test methods for various restart and kill scenarios.

classes.name: LivenessTests_SqlServer
classes.description: Test class for Orleans silo membership liveness using SQL Server as the backend.

classes.name: LivenessTests_PostgreSql
classes.description: Test class for Orleans silo membership liveness using PostgreSQL as the backend.

classes.name: LivenessTests_MySql
classes.description: Test class for Orleans silo membership liveness using MySQL as the backend.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configuration class implementing IHostConfigurator to set up Orleans clustering with ADO.NET for each test class.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if the relational storage preconditions are met before running tests.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with the relational storage connection string and silo configurator.

methods.name: Liveness_SqlServer_1
methods.description: Test method for SQL Server liveness check.

methods.name: Liveness_SqlServer_2_Restart_Primary
methods.description: Test method for restarting the primary node in SQL Server setup.

methods.name: Liveness_SqlServer_3_Restartl_GW
methods.description: Test method for restarting the gateway in SQL Server setup.

methods.name: Liveness_SqlServer_4_Restart_Silo_1
methods.description: Test method for restarting silo 1 in SQL Server setup.

methods.name: Liveness_SqlServer_5_Kill_Silo_1_With_Timers
methods.description: Test method for killing silo 1 with timers in SQL Server setup.

methods.name: Liveness_PostgreSql_5_Kill_Silo_1_With_Timers
methods.description: PostgreSQL kill silo 1 with timers test.

methods.name: Liveness_MySql_5_Kill_Silo_1_With_Timers
methods.description: MySQL kill silo 1 with timers test.
